in_sanskrit.name: सरभजीत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सर्वं जीत (sarvaṃ jīta) - 'Victory over all', भगवान् (bhagvān) - 'God', सर्भ (sarabh) - 'All'.

in_hindi.name: सरभजीत

in_marathi.name: Sarabjeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God is great
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarabjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sarab means 'great' and jeet means 'victory'. Sarabjeet means 'God is great, God is the victor'.

in_bengali.name: Sarabjeet
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God is great
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sarabjeet একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sarab means 'great' and jeet means 'victory'. Sarabjeet means 'God is great, God is the victor'.
